body.name: Algebraic foldwise weighted least-squares panel regression
body.construction: For each \((s,k)\), set \(u_{stk}=(X_{st}-\widetilde z_{sk})/h_{sk}\), \(w_{stk}=K(u_{stk})\), and \(e_0=b_r(0)\). On a successful selected fit define \((\widehat\theta_{sk},\widehat\gamma_{sk})\) as a minimizer of \[\frac{1}{n_s}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}-\theta-e_0^{\top}\gamma]^2+\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}[Q_{sti}-b_r(u_{stk})^{\top}\gamma]^2.\] Equivalently, use one block-diagonal stacked regression: event rows have \(D=1\), polynomial row \(e_0\), and weight \(1/n_s\); historical rows have \(D=0\), polynomial row \(b_r(u_{stk})\), and weight \(w_{stk}\); outer block weights are \(\pi_s/K_D\). Define \(\theta_{\mathrm{FWL}}=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_sK_D^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}\widehat\theta_{sk}\).
